matches.text: The independent reference closes the probe channel with a lossless reflector of phase phi, computes the coherent two-terminal transmission, and uniformly averages its Bernoulli cumulants. This averages the **log generating function**, not a probability generator of a quenched phase mixture. Its equivalence to the voltage probe applies here because there is exactly one single-channel probe and energy-independent scattering. It would generally fail for multiple probes or channels. See [Förster, Samuelsson, Pilgram and Büttiker, Voltage and dephasing probes: a full counting statistics discussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/cond-mat/0609544), and [Pilgram et al., Full counting statistics for voltage and dephasing probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/cond-mat/0512276).
